high_level_description: This image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or a similar indoor space. The individual is shirtless, wearing dark shorts, and standing barefoot on a tiled floor. They are holding a smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the photo. The mirror has a metallic frame and reflects the person's image as well as part of the room behind them. In the reflection, there is a cardboard box with some text partially visible, including the word "SHINE.
